Have you ever wondered why desire can feel so distant—even when love is right by your side? Welcome to this journey, where we look beneath the surface of everyday routines and explore what really happens to passion in long-term relationships. Together, we’re stepping into the world that Esther Perel paints in Mating in Captivity: Reconciling the Erotic and the Domestic, where the sparks and struggles of intimacy are both brought into the light.
We all crave comfort, but sometimes, that very comfort makes excitement seem just out of reach. Why does the security we build with someone sometimes make it harder to keep the fire burning? That tension—between feeling safe and wanting to feel alive—is at the heart of what we’re about to discover together.
Through real stories, honest insights, and some thought-provoking questions, we’ll challenge what we think we know about things like monogamy, fidelity, and emotional closeness. We’re going to see how freedom and belonging, being our own person and being part of a couple, can actually work together—if we’re willing to look at things a little differently.
As we blur the lines between the erotic and the everyday, get ready to open up to new ways of connecting and finding fulfillment. Let’s explore what it really means to thrive in love—and how we can all create richer, more passionate relationships. The stage is set for an honest, transformative look at intimacy’s most enduring questions.
